name: CompanyCam
description: A camera for the job site. Each photo keeps the project, the place, and the time, so a contractor can show what was done. Lincoln, Nebraska. Roofers, restorers, remodelers.

mentions.evidence: GetLatka shows an estimate of about $68 million a year as of November 2024, up from about $32 million in 2023. The company has not published revenue. In August 2025 a Series C led by B Capital was reported at a $2 billion valuation, called the first Nebraska company at that mark. The valuation is not revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: The same timestamped photo for a narrower job. A cleaning crew. The check-in and check-out of a rental.

whyItPrints: The photo is the paperwork for an insurance claim, a warranty, or an argument with the customer.
whyThisMatters: The argument after a roof job is about what the crew actually did. CompanyCam is the camera that files each photo under the project, the place, and the time, so a roofer, a restorer, or a remodeler can show the work. Lincoln, Nebraska. It sounds like a feature. Insurance, warranties, and unhappy customers are why it is a product. GetLatka's estimate is about sixty-eight million a year as of November 2024, up from about thirty-two million in 2023. The company has not published those figures. In August 2025 a Series C led by B Capital was reported at a two billion valuation, and the local press called it the first Nebraska company at that mark. A valuation is what investors paid for a slice. It is not the year's sales. The same camera, narrowed to one job, is a cleaning crew's before-and-after, or the photos at the start and end of a rental stay.
